paint.shared.objects

Class ExperimentInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo

  • public class ExperimentInfo
extends Object
    Represents all metadata and associated data objects for a single experiment recording in the PAINT analysis framework.

    This class contains experiment-level descriptive metadata as well as references to the square and track objects produced during analysis.

    The schema for ExperimentInfo is embedded directly in ExperimentInfo.Column, which binds human-readable CSV headers to their corresponding Tablesaw types. Table I/O classes use this enum for all schema operations.
